description: Extension of CanvasWindowController providing helper functions for session key sanitization, JavaScript string escaping, frame state saving/restoring, and UserDefaults interactions.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller class managing a window for a drawing canvas, extended here with helper functions.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string by trimming whitespace and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a string as a JSON-compliant JavaScript string literal.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Provides a JavaScript string literal for an optional string, or 'null' if nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a UserDefaults key string for storing window frame state for a given session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Loads and returns a saved window frame rectangle from UserDefaults for a given session key, with size validation.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores a window frame rectangle into UserDefaults for a given session key.
